items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: For a while I used Ted Demuth, he's the leader here, isn't he? Ted. Yeah. Yeah. A fine trombone player.

ctx.x: But how many members were in your band in the twenties?

In the twenties. Now let me explain to you. I would give them anything they wanted. I had big bands. I'd picture here, show you, oh, old Star outfits. I had seven key men. Two trumpets, three saxes, and three rhythms. And I used to use them. For a while I used Ted Demuth, he's the leader here, isn't he? Ted. Yeah. Yeah. A fine trombone player. And Ted was in the Marines at that time. He used to come on a boat in his Marine uniform to play the first set, because he just so much could make it. And I wasn't going to…
Do you remember orchestras that were back in those days that sounded like the New Leviathan Orchestra does?
